# Test fixtures (real media)

Regenerate with `node scripts/make-fixtures.mjs` (downloads pinned sdists, verifies SHA-256, extracts files, and
generates media with the project's own ffmpeg.wasm and Chromium). Used only by tests — never shipped in the site.

| finance/reference.json | `python3 scripts/make-finance-reference.py` (needs `pip install mpmath numpy-financial`; seeded): the finance calculators' reference. **EMI** — 936 loans worked month by month in mpmath at 420 digits (instalment; principal, interest and balance of the first, middle and last year) and eight whole schedules; 540 of them cross-checked with numpy-financial's pmt / ipmt / ppmt. **SIP** — 1,430 plans carried forward month by month (with yearly step-ups), 120 cross-checked with numpy-financial's fv; 180 lump sums. **FD / RD** — 1,100 deposits and 1,000 recurring deposits by compound interest in mpmath, quarterly ones also by the formula Indian banks publish; 40 effective yields. **GST** — 1,126 amount × rate pairs in the four modes by Python's decimal with ROUND_HALF_UP on the typed text. **Percentage** — 841 pairs of numbers for the six questions in exact fractions. Values beyond a double are `null` (the calculators must refuse them). |
